name: Пастки: ловля фігури й відкритий напад (2)

examples.pgn: {[%cal Rf3d4,Gc2d3] [#]} 1. Ne1 $1 Bd3+ 2. Nxd3 Rxc1+ 3. Nxc1 *
examples.text:
White can attack the pinned bishop with 1.Nd4 and 1.Ne1. In both cases, Black can remove the bishop with check (1…Bd3+) and it seems as if White is the one losing material. After 1.Nd4 (red arrow) this is indeed the case.

1.Ne1, on the other hand, wins a bishop. After 1…Bd3+ White can capture the bishop and thus cover the rook: 2.Nxd3 Rxc1+ 3.Nxc1. So don't stop calculating too quickly!

texts: Attack a pinned piece again. Make the right choice.
